name: SD: City waste and recycling (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A city's recycling, weighed every day in tonnes: recyclables sitting in household bins, material loaded on collection trucks, the sorting facility's backlog, sorted bales waiting for buyers, recycled products on shop shelves, and the landfill. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the city (the ground truth is in sd-recycling/truth.model.json, including a stock nobody weighs), so discovery can be checked exactly. What households throw away changes with the seasons without notice; changes at the sorting facility are announced as eras. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
